author: Mark Atwood
text:
Blocked on JMAP-826m.8. This bead's fix direction explicitly references mail-server's IdFate HashMap-based dedup algorithm as the correct pattern (per JMAP-826m.8's propagation analysis), but JMAP-826m.8 is currently human-labeled awaiting the propagation-direction decision (propagate canonical to siblings vs document the divergence vs propagate sibling shape back up to canonical).

Standalone fix that swaps Vec::contains for HashSet without adopting mail-server's IdFate would solve the O(n^2) but would create another cookie-cutter divergence — exactly what JMAP-826m.8 is trying to resolve. The two beads must be addressed in lockstep.

Will pick this up once .8 is decided.
